_comment: Fictional health-sciences objectives for choosing the near-duplicate threshold (ADR 044). Each row has the same meaning in English (en), Afrikaans (af) and isiXhosa (xh). 'same' = paraphrases that should be reported; 'different' = same style, different content, which must not be. The Afrikaans and isiXhosa wording was written by the model that built this slice and has NOT been checked by a native speaker: treat the results for those languages as indicative until a speaker has reviewed the file.
